x6.title: Excursion exc-6-governor-prototype: subagents separately tracked by the governor
x6.imperative: Prototype excursion per EXCURSION_BRIEF exc-6-governor-prototype on the ideas board. Dispatches constellation-prototyper in a throwaway worktree; proof includes the prototype creating its own subagents whose engine activity is gauged separately from the parent. Result lands at evidence/exc-6-governor-prototype-RESULT.md. Record the scoped verdict as the finding.
x6.finding: exc-6 ANSWERED-YES (evidence/exc-6-governor-prototype-RESULT.md): the governor fix is NOT pernicious. Harness 2.1.220 now writes each subagent its own transcript (subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl) with a distinct agentId; re-keying the binding on session_id#agentId makes separation fall out. Demonstrated live with real spawned sonnet subagents: separate bindings, per-agent gauges (own model + own fill), parent clean, terminal release removes the key. #383's two symptoms (accumulation + ambiguity-skip) are ONE bug with one fix. Also: main checkout currently holds 47 bindings/36 under one session (live confirmation); GAUGE_WRITER_HOOK.md's isSidechain guidance is now wrong load-bearingly; a stale-binding sweep is needed and now cheap. NOT tested: the real PostToolUse hook payload (excluded by handoff — CHECK FIRST, decides if fix is ~one line), identical-command race, real engine/spine_rail integration, migration of 47 live bindings. Surviving module agent_identity.py in worktree proto/exc6-governor-subagent-identity commit 75f684c.

x7.title: Excursion exc-7-simple-english: simplified technical English standard + glossary
x7.imperative: Research excursion per EXCURSION_BRIEF exc-7-simple-english on the ideas board. Primary sources on controlled English (ASD-STE100 etc.) + audit of this repo's own jargon; draft rules, glossary structure, and candidate mechanical checks. Result lands at evidence/exc-7-simple-english-RESULT.md. Record the scoped verdict as the finding.
x7.finding: exc-7 ANSWERED (evidence/exc-7-simple-english-RESULT.md): the problem is VOCABULARY not sentence length — measured medians 12-15 words already inside STE caps, but ~1 word in 40 is an undefined coined term and the repo has ZERO glossary/terminology headings anywhere. docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md is referenced in 4 places, owned by Charter with a written imperative, and does not exist — the slot is specified and empty. Proposal: 10 writing rules (ship 4/8/9 first: define-on-first-use, plain-statement-before-metaphor, expand notation), glossary format + 3 admission routes, 3 mechanical checks (PL001 undefined-term FAIL keyed off the glossary; PL002 length WARN — least valuable; PL003 coinage census report-only). STE verb rules deliberately NOT imported (would force overclaiming). Caveat flagged honestly: no evidence either way that jargon confuses agents — cheapest test named, read #331 first. Numeric STE rules from secondary sources — confirm against official Issue 9 PDF before writing numbers into doctrine.

consolidation.summary: Cycle 2 (refine, mechanisms+cleanup) complete: 3/3 excursions answered. (1) Governor fix PROVEN feasible in prototype — not pernicious; harness now emits per-subagent identity; re-key binding on session_id#agentId fixes both #383 symptoms at once; one open question (PostToolUse payload) decides if the production fix is ~one line. (2) Jargon problem is measured as VOCABULARY not sentence length — glossary slot exists, is referenced 4 places, and is empty; concrete plan: glossary first, 3 writing rules, one mechanical check keyed off the glossary. (3) Backlog: two independent passes now agree on 112 of 124 comparable issues; ~15 close candidates, 17 parkable real-later, 12 disagreements to adjudicate. All three feed a near-ready shape for the mechanisms+cleanup epic; convergence remains Tommy's call.
